title: Dorjay plans to find the Pole Star
body: Dorjay wants to find the Pole Star one evening. He decides to watch from the terrace of his house, where the outside lights stay on so that he can see his notebook. He picks the night of the full Moon because he thinks the bright moonlight will make the sky clearer. He plans to start searching the northern sky the moment he steps outside, carrying a magnetic compass and a printed picture of the Big Dipper and the Little Dipper. His elder sister will go with him. His teacher had told the class that the Pole Star is not a very bright star.
